name: Tạo tổ chức
pre: Phiên và xác minh email hợp lệ
steps: Nhập name
Tạo Organization và owner membership trong transaction
post: Một owner, role membership không chứa ownership
test: atomic owner membership, bounded list and cross-organization privacy

name: Xem tổ chức theo phạm vi
pre: Org membership active
steps: Lọc quyền trước phân trang
Tính role từ ownerId và membership DB
post: Không lộ tổ chức khác hoặc private mutationRevision
test: membership revocation, stale auth version and unverified user are denied at store

name: Tạo Workspace trực thuộc
pre: Org role quản trị còn hiệu lực
steps: Tạo Workspace organizationId/managerId, ownerId null
Tạo creator Workspace membership atomic
post: Tổ chức sở hữu Workspace, creator quản lý và làm việc tại đó
test: attached Workspace access covers Admin/Manager, work, inbox/mail and independent scope

name: Xem Workspace và công việc trực thuộc
pre: Active organization chain; membership Workspace trừ quyền quản trị cấp tổ chức
steps: Kiểm Organization và Workspace cùng phạm vi
Admin quản trị không tự có quyền nhận Task hoặc email override
post: Legacy standalone giữ owner quyền hiện tại
test: attached Workspace access covers Admin/Manager, work, inbox/mail and independent scope

name: Xem thành viên tổ chức
pre: Org membership active
steps: Search/date/cursor theo joinedAt
Chỉ trả tên/avatar/role/version, không email hoặc thông tin bảo mật
post: Danh sách trong tổ chức hiện tại
test: management API preserves layered roles, logs changes and notifies assigned members

name: Cấp hoặc thu hồi Admin
pre: Target active/verified, không phải owner; expectedVersion membership
steps: Chỉ admin/member, chặn tự cấp từ Member/Admin
CAS role và audit atomic
post: Vai trò Workspace độc lập không bị xóa; quyền quản trị mới có hiệu lực từ DB
test: management API preserves layered roles, logs changes and notifies assigned members

name: Bổ nhiệm hoặc thay Manager
pre: Workspace thuộc đúng Org; target là Org member active/verified; expectedVersion Workspace
steps: Bảo đảm target là Workspace member
Đổi managerId, giữ Manager cũ là Member
Ghi audit, thông báo nếu vừa thêm target
post: Một Manager chính; Org role của người đó giữ nguyên
test: management API preserves layered roles, logs changes and notifies assigned members

name: Phân bổ Member nội bộ vào Workspace
pre: Target thuộc Org active/verified, expectedVersion Workspace
steps: Tạo hoặc reactivate membership, reset override nếu reactivate
Không yêu cầu chấp nhận lại
Ghi audit và in-app membership notification trong transaction
post: Không cấp Org membership hoặc role mới; retry/no-op không tạo notification lặp
test: management API preserves layered roles, logs changes and notifies assigned members

name: Chuyển ownership tổ chức
pre: Target là Org member active/verified; expectedVersion Organization
steps: CAS ownerId, giữ role membership riêng
Ghi audit atomic
post: Owner cũ mất quyền từ ownership, các role được cấp riêng còn giữ; không có hai owner
test: management API preserves layered roles, logs changes and notifies assigned members

name: Xem nhật ký quản trị
pre: Quyền quản trị còn hiệu lực
steps: Lọc organizationId trước pagination
Trả actor/target/action/role change/time
post: Không có password/token/Comment content
test: management API preserves layered roles, logs changes and notifies assigned members

name: Mời Member vào tổ chức qua email
pre: Org management role active; optional Workspace belongs to Org
steps: Validate exact email and reject elevated role
Queue encrypted mail; notify existing recipient without creating membership
post: Pending email invitation; no plaintext token in DTO
test: email-only Member invitation, public preview, encrypted outbox and in-app recipient scope

name: Xem và chấp nhận lời mời tổ chức
pre: Valid unconsumed invitation, verified exact email for accept
steps: Preview minimal Organization/Workspace scope
Commit Org membership and optional Workspace in transaction
Consume invitation, cancel unsent delivery
post: Member only; existing active roles retained, inactive rejoin does not restore Admin
test: concurrent accept-by-ID creates single membership and optional Workspace atomically

name: Thu hồi lời mời tổ chức
pre: Invitation in current Org; CAS version
steps: Serialize against accept
Mark revoked and cancel unsent outbox
post: Cannot accept revoked invitation
test: unverified, revoked, expired and stale invitations cannot grant access

name: Rời tổ chức
pre: Current membership version; ownership and Manager handoffs completed
steps: Revoke Org and descendant Workspace memberships
Clear unfinished assignees including Archived; preserve Done/creator/comment
Cancel queued work mail
post: Independent Workspaces/account unchanged; rejoin does not restore old assignments
test: leave cascades Workspace rights, assignees and queued work email but preserves history and standalone

name: Loại Member khỏi tổ chức
pre: Owner protected; Admin cannot remove Admin; Manager replacement required; CAS membership
steps: Validate hierarchy and current target
Apply same exit cascade and audit
post: Kick does not ban; new valid invitation may rejoin, prior Admin role not automatically restored
test: owner/admin protection, Manager handoff and accept/revoke race remain consistent

name: Assign Project Lead
pre: Active Project, verified target with current Workspace membership, Project CAS
steps: Check parent role and target membership
Assign/clear leadId, audit change
post: Lead has Project-scoped Task/description permissions only
test: Lead requires current Workspace membership and cannot manage other Projects or Workspace

name: Invite Project Guest
pre: Active Project and current management permission
steps: EMAIL exact recipient or reusable LINK, always Guest
Hash token, queue encrypted EMAIL and recipient Inbox
post: No membership until verified explicit accept
test: Guest EMAIL/LINK acceptance never creates Org/Workspace membership; reads only shared Project

name: Guest reads/comments shared Project
pre: Active Project Guest grant, valid parent chain
steps: Read only shared Project
Write own Comment in Active; reject Task writes and Workspace roster
post: Creator/Assignee history cannot override Guest-only permissions
test: former Creator/Assignee returning as Guest has no inherited Task write permission

name: Revoke Guest or invitation
pre: Current parent scope and grant/invitation CAS
steps: Revoke grant or invitation separately
Keep Comments, record access audit
post: No access from revoked grant; other roles unchanged; link revoke does not remove already joined Guest
test: Guest revoke/link revoke and concurrent Lead changes respect CAS and current access

name: Scoped Ban and reviewed Comment cleanup
pre: Verified current scope authority, target below role; signed review for cleanup
steps: Preview count/cutoff and bind selection
Commit Ban/revoke cascade/job atomic
Worker deletes scoped author Comments in bounded batches
post: No new access/accept; no Task/doc deletion; failed cleanup does not rollback Ban
test: Project Guest Ban blocks read/accept/list immediately; cleanup batches keep other scopes/content

name: Unban and cleanup retry
pre: Current role and Ban/action version; failed job for retry
steps: Unban logs decision, does not restore roles/membership/content
Retry keeps cursor/time/scope selection
post: Fresh invitation/assignment needed; sibling bans remain effective
test: Kick allows valid rejoin; Ban requires unban and never restores membership automatically

name: Delete Comment permanently
actor: Author in Active; authorized moderator including Archived
pre: Current Project scope, Comment CAS; reason required for moderation
steps: Validate author/moderator rights
Delete physical Comment and metadata audit atomic
post: No body copy or restore; others cannot edit author text
test: hard delete is author-only for edits, moderator with reason even Archived, audit never stores body

name: Context profile card
pre: Reader access; Guest target associated with visible work
steps: Resolve current scoped status/role
Return name/avatar/departed status, no email/security/other Org data
post: No long status tag appended to displayName; moderation blocked flag only authorized management
test: Organization Ban revokes descendants, archived assignments and Manager slots, not other organizations

name: Priority and Project labels
pre: Current scope/active/CAS; labels belong to Project
steps: Validate typed input and scoped authorization at commit
Return bounded DTO based on committed data
post: No Guest writes; archived labels retain history and cannot be assigned
test: Project label management, scoped assignment, archive and CAS

name: Checklist and Done warning
pre: Current role/CAS, UUID items; explicit incomplete confirmation
steps: Validate typed input and scoped authorization at commit
Return bounded DTO based on committed data
post: Assignee cannot alter structure; changed data requires new confirmation
test: Checklist structure/ticks preserve IDs and checked state; races and Done confirmation

name: Stable code and completion history
pre: Atomic Project counter; unique prefix/code indexes
steps: Validate typed input and scoped authorization at commit
Return bounded DTO based on committed data
post: Code never reused; Done no-op keeps timestamp; unknown historical time stays null
test: Atomic readable codes, parallel creation, search and no reuse after deletion

name: My Tasks deadline groups
pre: Current membership/Ban/filter; Vietnam day bounds
steps: Validate typed input and scoped authorization at commit
Return bounded DTO based on committed data
post: Counts describe full filtered set, not a cursor page; Board newest sort stays
test: My Tasks deadline counts cover filtered full set, not current cursor page

name: Request/review Task reopen
actor: Current Creator/Assignee and independent scope management
pre: Done Active/current scope; pending unique; CAS Task and Request; bounded reason/rates
steps: Validate current permissions and typed input
Commit bounded scoped results/transactional mutation
post: Approve atomically reopens/clears completedAt/revalidates assignee; reject leaves Done; self-review/bypass denied
test: BE/test/reopen-mongo.test.js

name: Reopen pending lifecycle
pre: Current parent chain/requester relationship/access
steps: Validate current permissions and typed input
Commit bounded scoped results/transactional mutation
post: Cancel without replay on rejoin/unban/unarchive; changing Lead keeps request but changes reviewer authority
test: BE/test/reopen-mongo.test.js

name: Current Project progress/statistics
pre: Real current nondeleted Tasks; optional Vietnam calendar period
steps: Validate current permissions and typed input
Commit bounded scoped results/transactional mutation
post: No other scope leak; reopened Tasks excluded from current Done/period; legacy completion time unknown retained
test: BE/test/reopen-mongo.test.js

name: Workspace Archive and Unarchive
pre: Current scoped management + name/reason/CAS; unarchive valid Manager
steps: Check current authority/state/parent chain
Commit transaction and scoped metadata audit
post: Read-only children, Project own state stays; no replay on unarchive
test: BE/test/retention-mongo.test.js

name: Task Trash and Restore
pre: Current editor; active parent/CAS/before deadline to restore
steps: Check current authority/state/parent chain
Commit transaction and scoped metadata audit
post: Preserves code/data/history, validates Assignee, no work event replay
test: BE/test/retention-mongo.test.js

name: Automatic retention purge
pre: 30d expired valid scheduled trash, actual parent chain/version after guard
steps: Check current authority/state/parent chain
Commit transaction and scoped metadata audit
post: Atomic scoped children + metadata audit deletion; no reused code; legacy unscheduled skip
test: BE/test/retention-mongo.test.js
